profile.description: Lyft operates as a global mobility platform offering a mix of rideshare, taxis, private hire vehicles, executive chauffeur services, car sharing, bikes and scooters. Substantially all of its revenue is generated from its ridesharing marketplace that connects drivers and riders.
profile.about_source: Lyft Form 10-K for 2025, Item 1 (full-time employees as of Dec 31, 2025)
